ops.text: This room is empty save a strong smell of perfume.
You interrupt a woman.  "Get out!  I shall have the town guard throw you in prison for this!"  You narrowly dodge a vase that is thrown at you.

This room lies undisturbed.  As you stand in the doorway, you feel a strong desire to leave this room.  That might explain why thieves have not pilfered the coffin in this room.  It lies covered in centuries'  old dust.  Do you approach it?

The coffin is made of solid stone with a stone lid.  Dust leaps into the air as you pass across the floor.  You are the first person to enter this crypt in countless years.  The coffin must contain one of the first occupants of this now decrepit tomb.
You walk in as a rather embarrassed man finishes buttoning up his robe.  He mills about gathering his things and leaves in a hurry.
A gnome is surprised by your boldness.  "I will ask you to leave.  I have friends in the town militia.  It would be best if I did not have to give them your names."  Do you leave?
Having called his bluff, he gives you a stern look and stomps out of the room.  "You shall regret your hasty decision!"
This chamber has been looted.  You find nothing of interest.
A burley dwarven warrior is snoring loudly on the bunk.  Several empty flagons of ale are scattered about the room.  Do you wake him?

He awakes with a start.  As he shakes the cobwebs from his head he begins to pat his belt.  Suddenly he stands and begins to shout, "Hey!  Who stole me purse!" Without hesitation he grabs a nearby ax and begins to swing.
"Me be tinkin me be knowing who has me purse!  Me be tinkin on getting it back, just quick."
This room is empty save a strong smell of perfume.
You step into a foyer that has not seen use in countless years.  A heavy gloom settles over you.  This once holy place has taken on an atmosphere of despair.  You feel great evil is afoot.
The evil feeling runs so deep as to prevent any Priest or Crusader from turning.

A huge crystal sphere is being held aloft  by a net of strands.  These strands appear to be made from living, scaled flesh that has materialized out of thin air.  Inside the sphere, you see a whirling vortex of mist.

This seems to be the source of the evil  you have felt throughout the temple.   A shimmering, impenetrable energy field surrounds the sphere.   Demonic symbols are engraved on the floor to the sides of the energy field.
The symbols are large enough for four people to kneel inside.  Do four members of the party wish to step inside?
Who is so brave as to volunteer?

Upon kneeling on the symbols, a magical display of energy sweeps across the floor. Energy beams of light in a myriad of colors appear from all directions.  They strike all those not within the symbols.
A storeroom.  Nothing of interest as far as you can see.  You could rest in here without being found.
A storeroom.  Nothing of interest as far as you can see.  You could rest in here without being found.
This room is empty save a strong smell of perfume.
This room is empty save a strong smell of perfume.

Waiting for you at the bottom of the stairs is the small gnome you so rudely interrupted upstairs.  Behind him is a large group of armed militia.  "That's them Boron!  That group right there.  Now if you want your gold, you will have to earn it."
In the far corner of the room is a large skeleton of some demonic beast.  Centuries of dust cover it's now decimated body.  It has something gripped in it's clawed hand.
You notice a large iron box under a loose floorboard.  It would appear that you have found the profits from the brothel.

You enter the town archives.  An old withered man with dried leather for skin sits perched behind a sturdy desk.  He is scratching at some parchment with an ink quill.  As you approach, he frowns and looks up with a furrowed brow.  "Sssshhhh!"

"You people make more noise than a herd of rampaging Trollocs."  He continues with a sour look upon his face, "What is it that you want?  We are very busy here.  You may look around, but do not bother me unless I am needed."
This is an old storeroom that now contains nothing but rot and decay.  A few casks of wine still remain, but a sampling shows that it has long since gone bad.
As you pass through the door, a strong wave of evil washes over you. You almost bolt for the door.  Whatever lies beyond must be pure evil.  Pure evil radiates outward.
Numerous cots with rotted legs have collapsed into termite-infested heaps.
Pulling the items from the creatures clenched fist you find a long bull whip.  The leather is in perfect condition after all these years.  It's obviously magical in nature.
This room is inhabited by both the dead and the undead.  Several ghouls are feasting on some of the fresher corpses.  They intend to feast on you as well.
This room is inhabited by both the dead and the undead.  Several ghouls are feasting on some of the fresher corpses.  They intend to feast on you as well.

This room is the only area so far that does not emanate a strong aura of evil.  In the center of this large room, is a tall stone statue.   There is an air of peace about this place that suggests you could rest here safely.
This room is occupied by small, fluttering shapes not native to the Realmz.  They immediately swarm upon you.
You descend a flight of stairs and  face a long, colorless hallway.  The lifeless air is close and stifling.  Your heels kick up ancient dust.
You dead end at a set of primarily empty chambers.  Some warped spears and a set of rusty armor lay in an abandoned heap in the far left corner of this chamber.

You rummage about the old pile of armor and weapons and find one item of interest.  A large sack of barbed jacks.  As you rummage around, you stir up a thick cloud of dust and are overtaken by a severe sneezing fit.
A ghostly apparition now stands at the room's center.  Raising a smoky tendril-like arm in your direction, it speaks in the ancient fespian tongue. "Seek! Ye shall find only death here."

Old rotted bodies lay about the room like an army of broken rag dolls-a twitching arm, a disembodied head- scattered parts are all that remain of this ungodly army.  Before you can regain your full strength, yet another figure emerges from the alcove.
Unlike the others, this figure must stoop to enter the room.  It is a massive zombie heading up a multitude of lesser zombies.
In the far corner of the room is a large skeleton of some demonic beast.  Centuries of dust cover it's now decimated body.  It has something gripped in it's clawed hand.
Pulling the items from the creatures clenched fist you find a long bull whip.  The leather is in perfect condition after all these years.  It's obviously magical in nature.
Town guards rush towards you.  The corporal in charge screams, "They are the ones who murdered the good Magistrate.  Kill them!"  Troops are upon you before you can make good your escape.
